title: This Snake Flattens Its Body and Glides 79 Feet Through the Air

scenes.text: Some snakes launch themselves off trees and glide.
Flying snakes live in the forests of South and Southeast Asia.
They leap from a branch about 49 feet up.
Then they flatten their bodies and wiggle through the air.
Scientists filmed them gliding at least 79 feet from tree to tree.
No wings. No legs. Some snakes can fly, sort of.

description:
Some snakes launch themselves off trees and glide.
Flying snakes flatten their bodies and undulate through the air, and scientists have filmed them gliding at least 79 feet from tree to tree.
Would you want to see one in person?
first_comment: Flying snakes have no wings. What other animal glides without them?
